title: SDD harness project configuration
description: Per-repo configuration consumed by the sdd plugin's skills and agents. Place this file at the repo root as .claude/sdd/config.json. Every field is optional; when omitted, skills auto-detect from package.json / pyproject.toml / Makefile and fall back to the documented defaults.

$schema.description: JSON schema URI for editor validation.

commands.description: Shell commands for the project's toolchain. Placeholders in skills map to these keys.

test.description: <TEST_CMD> — run the full test suite. e.g. 'npm test', 'pytest'

testOne.description: <TEST_CMD> <test-file> template — run a single test file. Use {file} as the placeholder, e.g. 'npm test {file}', 'pytest {file}'. If omitted, '<test> <file>' is assumed.

lint.description: <LINT_CMD> — run the linter. e.g. 'npm run lint', 'ruff check .'

build.description: <BUILD_CMD> — build the project. e.g. 'npm run build', 'python -m build'

dev.description: <DEV_CMD> — start the dev server (foreground form). e.g. 'npm run dev'

devHost.description: <DEV_HOST_CMD> — start the dev server bound to all interfaces. e.g. 'npm run dev -- --host'

shoot.description: <SHOOT_CMD> — run the named observation set headless and exit non-zero on a budget breach. e.g. 'npm run shoot'. Read by the render plugin's skills.

dir.description: <SOURCE_DIR> — root of application source, used to scope diffs (git diff -- <dir>/).

configFile.description: The test runner's config file, used by /test to detect whether tests are configured. e.g. 'vitest.config.ts', 'pyproject.toml'

devServer.description: Dev server reachability, used by the tester agent and screenshot steps.

url.description: Base URL the dev server is reachable at once started.

branching.description: Branch topology. GitHub Flow is the default (devBranch == mainBranch); trunk-based uses the same shape, and Gitflow-style repos set a separate devBranch.

devBranch.description: <DEV_BRANCH> — the integration branch features are cut from and PR'd into. Defaults to main, matching mainBranch, which is GitHub Flow; set a separate branch (e.g. development) only for Gitflow.

docs.description: Documentation layout in the consuming repo.

root.description: Docs root. specs live at <root>/specs/<domain>/, index at <root>/INDEX.md, ADRs at <root>/decisions/.

render.description: Perceptual-verification layout, read by the render plugin. Omit entirely for projects with no visual output.

framesPath.description: The named observation set — one entry per frame, each with a required intent.

themePath.description: The configuration layer: the only file allowed to contain colour literals.

shotsDir.description: Where captures land. Gitignore the images; commit the index.

standard.description: The look contract and its traps table.
